## Problem and result

Closes #<issue>

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. State scope and any API/storage/migration compatibility implications.

## Verification

List commands and observed results, skipped checks with reasons, and meaningful regression coverage. Do not include secrets or claim untested integrations.

## Review and rollout

- [ ] Sol implemented in an isolated issue branch without unrelated commits.
- [ ] Astra independently reviewed the latest head SHA (record SHA and review link/result).
- [ ] Actionable findings are resolved; required CI succeeds on that same head.
- [ ] Migration/rollback and security implications are addressed, or do not apply.

Note residual limitations and any manual release steps. Merge and deployment are separate actions. Unattended dispatch, automatic review, GitHub App/OIDC deployment are not configured.
